title: Jimmy Carter's 2,458-acre family farm in Georgia acquired for conservation; wildlife area to expand to 7,000 acres, public access planned from 2027
summary_full: The Conservation Fund has acquired the Carter family farm to protect it as wildlife habitat. Plans include opening the property to the public for outdoor activities before its state transfer. This acquisition will expand the nearby Lanahassee Creek Wildlife Management Area, enhancing conservation efforts in Georgia. The Carter family, recognizing its historical significance, supports the preservation initiative for future generations.
